author: potuz
content: And not Kev That is not what I am saying, what I am saying is that we need to understand why these retention periods exist or not. If we are forcing nodes to keep data because they'll need regenerate state in case we are not finalizing then we are dead way way earlier than 4 months not finalizing. If we need to keep data so that someone does not want to rely on checkpoints even if finalizing that's silly cause the assumption is still 1 of N: that someone will feed you the data. If we need to keep data to make sure it's available then that's a different story. At any rate, the CL side does not need this data at all if we are finalizing, we **only** need it because we are forced to serve it

author: wemeetagain
content:
> CL side does not need this data at all if we are finalizing
If you _enforce_ using checkpoint sync (which is not the current spec), then you don't need the data. Otherwise its used to forward sync, eg when a node is offline for a time within the ws period and needs to catch up via forward sync.
